player_prompt.intro:
Ndinu Player {player_id} mu **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Tumizani chaguo chanu monga **[macro  micro]** (nambari mbili 0-8):
• *macro*  = mini-bodi iliyo m'mene mumapikisana
• *micro* = malo aliyo ndani mwa mini-bodi
Mfano `[7 8]` ➜ weka chenjezo chanu mu mini-bodi 7, malo 8, ndipo
mkakati wako adzikhazikitse m'mini-bodi 8 yatsopano.

Ndinu `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kusuntha kuyenera kukhala mu mawonekedwe [macro micro] ndi manambala 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Mndandanda uliwonse uyenera kukhala pakati pa 0 ndi 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Mini-bodi, safu, kapena malo ali pachulu.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: M'chipinda cha ndende muli kale anthu ena.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Wosewerayo ayenera kuseŵera mu bolodi laling'ono lotsatira.

game_action.played: Mchezaji {player_id} wachita m'njira ya micro {macro_idx}, seli {micro_idx} (laizi {row}, kolomnde {col}). Mchezaji {opponent_id} akuyenera kuchita m'njira ya {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Wosewera {player_id} amapambana Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
